title: Sumerian astronomical knowledge

tellings.quote: You have Sumerian um architecture that shows a precocious knowledge of astronomy.

plain: The buildings of Sumer, one of the earliest civilisations, in ancient Mesopotamia, show a surprisingly early knowledge of astronomy. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in a conversation about Harvard studying UFOs. He offers it as a hint that ancient peoples knew more about the sky than expected.
